filter_tool1_lines: filter Turk tool1 lines to keep only those matching training dataset phrases and node types
filter_tool2_lines: filter Turk tool2 lines to keep only those with matching chat, tag, and node types
build_tree_inserts_dict: build a dictionary mapping chat commands to their tree insert subtrees from Turk tool lines
postprocess_tree: postprocess a Turk tool generated tree to convert it into the format expected by model datasets
update_tree_spans: update span indices in a tree by shifting them and reformatting Turk span format to dataset format
